PAC Jawan's Carbine Fires at Kashi Vishwanath Temple Gate, Three Injured

A Public Armed Contingent (PAC) jawan's carbine accidentally discharged at the gate of the Kashi Vishwanath Temple, injuring three people. The incident occurred near Gate Number 4B. The injured were taken to the hospital for treatment. Security agencies have initiated an investigation into the matter.
